content.short: Guardarian is a non custodial fiat on and off ramp for buying, selling, and swapping crypto with card, bank, and partner flows.
content.description: Guardarian is a fiat on and off ramp service that lets individuals and businesses buy, sell, and swap crypto through a non custodial exchange flow. Its official site and developer docs highlight global country coverage, support for many fiat currencies and cryptocurrencies, and partner integrations through API, hosted widgets, webhooks, and exchange status endpoints. For wallets and apps that support networks such as TON, Guardarian is mainly used as an infrastructure partner that adds regulated payment rails and simpler conversion between traditional money and crypto assets.
